purpose: Development-only calibration-input-contract diagnostic before a new robustness study; repairing preprocessing is not methodological novelty.

continuation_gate.scope: Engineering screening only, not a universal equivalence or significance threshold. Gate evaluated after reporting all four clean treatments. No corruption jobs are launched by this clean-only pilot.

limitations: Historical checkpoint-selection evaluation partition, not a new confirmatory holdout.
One calibration subset and one engine build per treatment; no seed or build-population inference.
No causal numerical-format claim: default INT8 and FP8 graph policies may differ.
Legacy versus matched INT8 isolates the calibration input contract at the recipe level, not normalization alone.
A successful baseline repair is not evidence of a new robustness method.
